text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some great news came in. Marvelous 
Sunday's mother... was invited to the 
academy as a special dance instructor!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mom's dance—Air Groove helped me practice 
it a whole bunch,
after all☆★ Time to show 
the results☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it looks like everyone has the 
choreography down for the most part!
Shall 
we move on to group practice next? And 
also—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Mommy's coming over! I danced perfectly, 
after all! I wonder if she'll praise me?!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chan... No,
Marvelous Sunday-san. You 
are—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Turn right here! Make it sharper! More 
dynamic...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa-whoa...! Marvelous-san, what 
incredible footwork...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
But I still have a long way to go!☆★ 
To perform like Mom...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...I know!
Let's try out even more stuff☆★ 
Like using this to make our hand
movements 
look bigger!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh! True! Having pom-poms looks flashy 
and fun... maybe?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We can use this, and a bunch of 
other fun items, and then, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it looks like it'll be a really 
lively dance. But... Marvelous, are you 
feeling rushed or something? Or is there 
something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huuuhm?? I don't know either~☆★ But 
earlier, Mom said—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"‘You're still missing something. I have 
to look into your eyes to tell you, 
right?’ ...she said."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I've mastered the choreography, and I 
should be dancing just like Mama! So 
what's still missing... I wonder~!?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm... So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Spe-chan! When you dance at a 
concert, what kind of feelings do you put 
into it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah? Me!? Umm...â

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I poured my gratitude toward my mom and 
all the fans cheering for me into it.
I'll become someone they can be even more
proud 
of.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's lovely. As for me... I guess 
I dance wishing to bring joy to the 
audience right in front of my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now—how is it marvelous? Why is it that 
you dance?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—! I see, that's it! What's important 
is...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, both of you!
I want to think of a way 
to pour even more of our feelings into 
this!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yes!☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Mother
text_block_list.text:
――OK... Your dance seems to have changed 
quite a bit, is there a particular goal 
behind it?

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Five, six, seven, eigh—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Reach them!☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Mother
text_block_list.text:
――OK... Your dance seems to have changed 
quite a bit, is there a particular goal 
behind it?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I remembered! Why it is that I dance.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's not so I can become like Mom! I want 
to give energy to the fans...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Win races, put on Lives,
and make all the 
fans marvelous—
because that's what I want 
to do! ☆★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I see... You've found 'what was missing', 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Excellent! Your performance was 
absolutely top-notch!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...!!
D-Did I deliver something Marvelous, 
just like Mom?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In fact,
Mom might even get overtaken 
herself☆

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, isn't that wonderful, Marvelous-san!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Yaaaaay!!☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Fuji,
Spe-chan! For giving me a 
hint……☆★ Thank you, thank you, thank 
youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
we learned a lot too. So we're even, 
Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—And the dance she showed me was this
one. 
Well? Mave-chan's grown so much, hasn't 
she~

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Indeed,
you've become even more marvelous. 
And... hehe,
you look just like you did in 
your younger days.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
The next time I see that girl, I'll have 
to praise her to the skies.
